githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 6 adds file cards with in-app downloads and previews, inline video and audio playback, unified spoilers, more mention types and Message Requests. It also improves uploads, composer menus, Discord-matching message layouts, voice and calls, and theme switching.

## Files, media and uploads

- Added file cards with macOS file icons; downloads now save straight to Downloads inside the app, show progress, and then offer Show in Finder.
- Added previews for text and code files, PDFs and other files Quick Look can open, which zoom out of their card and back into it when closed.
- Added an audio card with a compact player in the timeline, and a larger audio player in the viewer with animated 10-second skips.
- Added inline video playback in the timeline with play, scrubbing, volume and full screen, including in gallery tiles.
- Improved uploads so attachments start uploading as soon as they are attached, upload in parallel, and each show their own progress with cancel and Retry.
- Redesigned composer attachment tiles; sent files now fly from the composer into their message, and sent videos keep their real shape and first frame while uploading.
- Added Discord's warning before downloading potentially dangerous files.
- Improved media loading with blurred placeholders while images load, and media and spoilers now load while scrolling.

## Messages and composer

- Added Discord-style spoilers for text, images, videos, files, embeds and components; each one reveals on its own and stays revealed until you leave the channel.
- Added more mention types: timestamps in every style with live relative times, @everyone and @here pills, slash-command mentions that start the command, and game mentions. Hovering a timestamp shows its full date and time.
- Improved composer suggestions so emoji, mentions, times and games share the command argument menu, and the command list keeps a small gap at its edges while navigating with the arrow keys.
- Added animations when reactions arrive, change and leave.
- Improved message components, Markdown spacing and code blocks to match Discord, with press feedback on buttons, bot emojis in selects and an animated copy button on code blocks.
- Added the pointing-hand cursor to every clickable part of the timeline, and link-specific context menu actions.
- Fixed the reply ping turning back on when editing a reply sent without a ping, and the composer now grows from its top edge again.

## Channels and forums

- Added AutoMod alert messages showing the flagged content, rule, keyword and channel. Timeout, Kick and Ban actions are not available yet.
- Fixed forum posts that start without text showing "No Message"; they now show Discord's placeholder.
- Improved the forum header, search sidebar and closing a forum post, which now animate cleanly without flicker.
- Improved message history loading to match Discord's desktop client, and short channels keep loading older messages until the window is full.
- Fixed typing in a read-only channel switching to another channel.

## Friends, accounts and privacy

- Added Message Requests under Friends, with Requests and Spam tabs, Accept and Ignore. Report Spam is not available yet.
- Added management of blocked and ignored accounts in Privacy settings, and matched Discord's Add Friend page.
- Added Log in for saved accounts whose session Discord rejected, and a SakuraCord Contributor profile badge.

## Voice and calls

- Added pickers for a custom message sound and call ringtone.
- Changed incoming calls to ring inside the app instead of posting a banner.
- Fixed Deafen so it also mutes the microphone, matching Discord, and prevented duplicate voice engines and audio capture stalls.

## Appearance and reliability

- Fixed text keeping the previous theme's colours after switching between Light and Dark.
- Fixed slider thumbs disappearing while dragged inside sheets and the media viewer.
- Improved animated stickers so they render off the main thread.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.7-Beta-5...v0.1.7-Beta-6](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-5...v0.1.7-Beta-6)
discordAnnouncement:
**File previews, inline video, spoilers and Message Requests 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Files open as previews right in the app (PDFs, text, code and audio), and downloads save straight to your Downloads folder
- Videos play right in the chat, and uploads start the moment you attach a file, with progress on every file
- Spoilers look and behave like Discord everywhere, and timestamps, @everyone, command and game mentions all render properly
- Message Requests now sit under Friends, with Accept and Ignore
- Emoji, mention and command suggestions share one cleaner menu, and reactions animate in and out
- Calls ring inside the app with your own ringtone, and Deafen now mutes your mic too
